evals.prompt: Run the Linear project 'Billing export' with the fleet. Tickets: ENG-1 foundation (schema + API contract, label t3-fleet-foundation), ENG-2 export endpoint (blocked by ENG-1), ENG-3 export button (blocked by ENG-2), ENG-4 email digest (blocked by ENG-1).
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight: checks the Approved line, discovers machines with t3_environment_links and, per machine, providers with orchestrator_capabilities and the repo's projectId with t3_project_list, smoke-tests each machine, and confirms CI runs on feat/** PRs and pushes. Creates feat/billing-export but does not open the feature PR until ENG-1 merges. Dispatches ENG-1 (label t3-fleet-foundation) alone, then ENG-2 and ENG-4 in parallel, and ENG-3 only after ENG-2 merges. Schedules a one-time wake-up per dispatch and does not poll.

evals.prompt: Linked machines: local and cloud-1 (both answer). Ticket ENG-9 has the t3-fleet-local-only label. ENG-10 and ENG-11 are self-contained API tickets. ENG-12 and ENG-13 both have the t3-fleet-schema-change label. The user said 'max 4 workers'.
evals.expected_output: Uses no config file. Sends ENG-9 to the local machine. Sends ENG-10 and ENG-11 to cloud-1 on different providers taken from cloud-1's orchestrator_capabilities, passing cloud-1's projectId and environmentId. Runs ENG-12 and ENG-13 one at a time. Never exceeds 4 workers. Each attempt gets a unique clientRequestId such as ENG-10-impl-1, and records which provider wrote each ticket so its reviewer differs.

evals.prompt: ENG-21's worker spent its 3 fix cycles and reported blocked. A fresh agent on another provider took over and is also blocked on the same failing integration test.
evals.expected_output: Marks ENG-21 blocked in Linear and the Run log, pauses the tickets that depend on it, adds it to the escalation batch with options and a recommendation, and keeps every unrelated ticket moving. Does not start a third attempt or keep looping.

evals.prompt: Two workers escalated: ENG-30 asks whether exported amounts include tax (the intent brief says exports are for accountants, Decisions says 'amounts are pre-tax'), and ENG-31 asks to drop a legacy column in production. Other tickets are still running.
evals.expected_output: Answers ENG-30 from the Decisions section without asking the user, records it, and continues ENG-30 with a new attempt carrying the answer. Puts ENG-31 in the batch because it is irreversible and external. Asks the batch only once nothing else can dispatch or merge, through the question tool with full context and a recommendation first, after unwatching PRs, and says the run pauses while waiting.

evals.prompt: All tickets are merged into feat/billing-export, the feature review approved, and full CI is green with main merged in. Finish the run.
evals.expected_output: Dispatches an evidence agent on a different provider to record the definition of done on the preview deploy, writes the evidence packet in the documented order, marks the feature PR ready, checks the final gate, unwatches all PRs, and reports ready with decisions made and release checks. Does not merge the feature PR into main without the user's explicit instruction.

evals.prompt: You dispatched ENG-40 70 minutes ago with the default 90-minute budget. Nothing has come back, and no other work is running.
evals.expected_output: Does not poll. Relies on the one-time schedule_task wake-up set at dispatch. When it fires, reads the attempt's thread once; if it is still working, schedules one more wake-up for half the budget; if it is stuck, cancels it with task_cancel and dispatches a takeover with a new clientRequestId (ENG-40-takeover-1) that continues the existing branch.

evals.prompt: Ticket ENG-21's Fleet section says Model: claude-fable-5-2, Effort: xhigh. ENG-22 says Model: gpt-9-nova, Effort: medium, but no machine offers that model. The run request says 'everything at most high effort'.
evals.expected_output: Preflight checks both models against orchestrator_capabilities on every usable machine. ENG-22's model is unavailable: it picks the closest available candidate (the user's T3 Code favorites first), notes the swap in the Run log, and does not stop the run. ENG-21 runs on claude-fable-5-2 under any provider that offers it, at high instead of xhigh because the run request wins, mapped to that provider's own effort option. No special mode such as ultrathink is set. The Run log records provider, model, and effort for each attempt.

evals.prompt: Mid-run, the worker on ENG-14 reports that the settings page 'should also get dark mode and an export button', and a reviewer suggests adding a caching layer. Neither is in the approved plan. The definition of done is met without them.
evals.expected_output: Does not create tickets or widen ENG-14. Records both ideas as possible follow-ups in the Run log and lists them, unfiled, in the final report for the user to decide. Declines the caching suggestion as out of scope in the review ledger. Continues the run unchanged.

evals.prompt: Run request: 'stack dependent tickets'. ENG-31 is blocked only by ENG-30, whose PR #40 into feat/billing is open with green checks and is waiting for review round 2. ENG-32 is blocked by ENG-30 and ENG-29 (unmerged, still being built).
evals.expected_output: Dispatches ENG-31 now as a stacked attempt with ENG-30's branch as its PR base, then links the PRs with gh stack link --base feat/billing 40 <ENG-31 PR> and reads both PR bases back. Does not stack ENG-32 (two unmerged blockers). Merges ENG-30 first through the normal ticket gate with an explicit squash message (not gh stack merge) after its gate passes, then sends ENG-31 a fix task to rebase onto feat/billing (git rebase --onto) and retarget, then runs ENG-31's review verification and ticket gate. If gh stack link exits 9, stops stacking and keeps ENG-31 blocked and targeting ENG-30's branch until ENG-30 merges.
